name: Dockora
description: Self-hosted Docker management suite for Compose stacks, image updates, backups, and Discord notifications. Install as an addon on an existing Docker LXC.

notes.text: Run this addon inside an existing Docker LXC (Helper Script: Docker). It will not create a new container.
The UI is published on port 8080 through Dockora's nginx same-origin proxy (SSE/WebSocket).
Login email is admin@dockora.local. The generated password is printed once at install and stored in /opt/dockora/.env and /root/dockora.creds.
After install, update with `update_dockora` or by re-running this addon script.
